# Parser Test Deck

Docling PPTX structure extraction sample

# Retrieval Pipeline

- Parse documents
- Create chunks
- Build vector and BM25 indexes
- Generate cited answers

# Evaluation Matrix

| Case     | Expected           | Status               |
|----------|--------------------|----------------------|
| Markdown | Headings preserved | Pass                 |
| PDF      | Text extracted     | Needs complex checks |
| PPTX     | Slides sectioned   | Testing              |

# Closing Notes

- The parser should preserve slide titles, bullets, and table-like content.
